name: fix-feedback
description: Resolve required feedback and verified gaps on open change requests without merging.

interface.shortDescription: Fix required review feedback and verified gaps.
interface.longDescription: Repair only required unresolved review feedback, deterministic in-scope CI failures, and confirmed acceptance gaps, then push each original branch without merging.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $forge-steward-fix-feedback to repair the current change requests that have required unresolved feedback.
